svg.title: Docking architecture for Everlast RelationFlow
svg.desc: Shows how the NotebookLM clone plugs into the RelationFlow platform as a knowledge, RAG and Studio module via workspaces, roles (Owner, Editor, Viewer), an auto LLM router and the dedicated /api/v1/notebooks/:id/search endpoint.
